name: design-system-guardian
description: Requires explicit per-task and per-Figma-file library selection, then enforces exact approved design-system identities with Figma read-back, UX checks, preview-only rule validation, permission-bound machine-rule evaluation, exact-run judgment exceptions, and fail-closed evidence.
skillInstructions: When a Guardian skill is explicitly invoked, use the canonical package at ./plugins/design-system-guardian. At every new Guardian task or Figma file, ask which detected libraries to Use and Do not use; block visual work until the user confirms, never reuse an earlier selection silently, and forbid every unselected library. Preserve the optional signed enterprise route. Installation alone is not an always-on route and cannot prevent raw-tool bypass. Never copy or replace its policy, CLI, schemas, adapters, or sentinels. No sealed Guardian manifest means not Guardian-approved.

interface.shortDescription: Exact approved identities only, with fail-closed auditing.
interface.longDescription: For every new Guardian task or Figma file, require an explicit Use and Do not use library selection. Then set up locally with permission, build from exact selected Figma-bound design-system identities, perform preview-only rule validation, authorize machine-checkable usage rules, explain subjective judgment findings before offering exact-run exceptions, audit raw and effective results separately, and expose proven gaps through conspicuous sentinels. Unselected libraries are forbidden; signed enterprise onboarding remains optional.
